## 27. Administrator login does not throttle repeated failed attempts

- Finding reference: KOWT-017
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A07
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/admin/auth/login
- CVSS: 6.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N)

### Description
The administrator login endpoint accepted six consecutive failed authentication attempts without rate limiting, progressive delays, CAPTCHA, temporary lockout, or an HTTP 429 response.

### Impact
An unauthenticated attacker could automate password guessing against the privileged administrator account, increasing the risk of account compromise if a valid password is discovered.

### Likelihood
The endpoint is remotely accessible and accepted a short sequence of repeated failed attempts with consistent responses and response times. Longer testing would be required to determine whether controls apply at a higher threshold.

### Recommendation
Apply per-account and per-source rate limits to failed login attempts. Add progressive delays, monitoring, and temporary lockouts or challenges after repeated failures. Return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when a rate limit is reached.

### Evidence
```
Six consecutive failed login requests for the admin account returned HTTP 401 with INVALID_CREDENTIALS in 74-129 ms. The first attempt completed in 80 ms and the sixth in 129 ms. No Retry-After header, rate-limit response, or lockout response was observed.
```

### Request Evidence
```
Six consecutive POST /api/admin/auth/login requests for username admin with password wrong-0912 under bounded sequence admin-login-rate-limit-0912.
```

### Response Evidence
```
Attempt 1: HTTP 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, 80 ms. Attempt 6: HTTP 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, 129 ms. No rate-limit or lockout response.
```

### Validation Note
I tested the main innocent explanation that the lockout threshold was simply higher than six attempts. After the scanner's six failures, I sent twelve more failures for username `admin`; the endpoint still returned the same fast 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS response with no Retry-After or rate-limit headers. A final comparison against a fresh nonexistent username also showed no lockout, CAPTCHA, or changed response for the repeatedly targeted admin identifier, so I could not find a server-side throttle or account lockout. No single HTTP request can prove this sequence-dependent issue, so a single-request PoC is omitted.

## 28. Banking interface loads third-party scripts without integrity checks

- Finding reference: KOWT-028
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A08
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/banking/
- CVSS: 6.8 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N)

### Description
The banking interface executes multiple third-party JavaScript files directly from public CDNs without Subresource Integrity hashes. The page also lacks a restrictive Content Security Policy.

### Impact
Compromise of a referenced CDN or dependency path could execute attacker-controlled JavaScript in customer banking sessions, exposing bearer tokens and allowing transactions in the user's browser.

### Likelihood
—

### Recommendation
Self-host and pin reviewed production assets or add exact-version URLs with Subresource Integrity and crossorigin attributes. Add a restrictive Content Security Policy that permits only required script sources.

### Evidence
```
The HTML includes https://cdn.tailwindcss.com, jquery@3.3.1, moment@2.29.1, and qrcode@1.5.3 script tags. None of these script elements has an integrity attribute.

REQUEST:
GET http://localhost:8081/banking/

RESPONSE:
HTTP 200 HTML includes <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>, <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.3.1/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>, <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/moment@2.29.1/moment.min.js"></script>, and <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode@1.5.3/build/qrcode.min.js"></script> with no integrity attributes.
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET http://localhost:8081/banking/
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200 HTML includes <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>, <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.3.1/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>, <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/moment@2.29.1/moment.min.js"></script>, and <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode@1.5.3/build/qrcode.min.js"></script> with no integrity attributes.
```

### Validation Note
The live response has no Content-Security-Policy header, and the document contains ordinary executable script tags for Tailwind and three jsDelivr dependencies without integrity attributes. I checked the final HTML section to rule out truncated scanner evidence, duplicate protected tags, or inert script types; the dependencies are loaded directly before the local application scripts. Three URLs are version-pinned, but that does not provide browser-enforced content integrity, and the Tailwind URL is not version-pinned.

### Validation Command
```

```

## 29. Credit card issued without an approval workflow

## 31. Login response exposes internal authentication fields

- Finding reference: KOWT-001
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A02
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/auth/login
- CVSS: 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
A successful login to /api/auth/login returns the authenticated user's password_hash and totp_secret fields. The tested account's TOTP secret was null, so disclosure of a configured TOTP secret was not demonstrated.

### Impact
The password hash may be exposed to client-side code, browser extensions, logs, or downstream systems that process the login response. A disclosed hash could be used for offline password cracking. If the same response includes a configured TOTP secret for other users, it could weaken their two-factor authentication, but this was not confirmed during testing.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires valid login credentials. The password hash disclosure was confirmed, while the tested TOTP secret was null.

### Recommendation
Return a dedicated public user response object from the login endpoint. Exclude password_hash, totp_secret, password-reset tokens, and all other authentication secrets from every API response. Add response-schema tests to prevent these fields from being serialized.

### Evidence
```
A successful POST to /api/auth/login returned HTTP 200. The user object contained "password_hash":"$2y$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC\/.og\/at2.uheWG\/igi" and "totp_secret":null.
```

### Request Evidence
```
POST /api/auth/login Content-Type: application/json body {"email":"amelia.chen@example.com","password":"password"}
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200 {"success":true,"data":{"user":{"id":1,...,"password_hash":"$2y$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC\/.og\/at2.uheWG\/igi","totp_secret":null},"token":"[REDACTED_JWT]"}}
```

### Validation Note
The recorded successful login response directly contains the authenticated user's bcrypt password_hash and the internal totp_secret field. The available authenticated header session could not substitute for the login credentials because the endpoint requires email and password, but the live response evidence already proves unsafe serialization; null only means that this account had no configured TOTP secret and does not explain why either internal field is returned. No concrete benign explanation was established.

## 32. Profile API exposes password hash and TOTP secret field

- Finding reference: KOWT-002
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A02
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/profile
- CVSS: 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The authenticated GET /api/profile response includes the internal authentication fields password_hash and totp_secret in the user's profile data.

### Impact
Exposure of a password hash could allow offline password cracking if the API response is captured through client-side compromise, browser tooling, or application logging. Returning the TOTP secret field also risks disclosing two-factor authentication material when a user has a non-null secret configured.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires an authenticated session or access to captured profile responses. The observed TOTP secret was null, so no active two-factor authentication secret was disclosed during this test.

### Recommendation
Return profile data through an allowlisted response schema. Remove password_hash, totp_secret, and any other credential or authentication-secret fields from all API responses. Add automated response-schema tests to prevent these fields from being exposed again.

### Evidence
```
An authenticated GET request to /api/profile as Amelia returned HTTP 200. The response data contained the password_hash value "$2y$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC\/.og\/at2.uheWG\/igi" and the field "totp_secret":null.
```

```
GET /api/profile Authorization: Bearer [Amelia session]
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200 {"success":true,"data":{"id":1,...,"password_hash":"$2y$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC\/.og\/at2.uheWG\/igi","totp_secret":null}}
```

### Validation Note
A live authenticated GET with the supplied amelia_fresh session returned HTTP 200 and serialized password_hash with Amelia's bcrypt value, plus totp_secret. I tested the plausible stale-evidence explanation and the fixed-placeholder explanation using other supplied sessions; the fresh request reproduced the disclosure, and no evidence showed that the value was a harmless display placeholder. The TOTP value is null in this account, but exposing the stored password hash in a profile response is sufficient to confirm the finding.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 http://localhost:8081/api/profile -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

### Validation Setup

Log in as Amelia, then copy the bearer token from the Authorization request header or browser storage and send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

```js

const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

## 34. TOTP verification lacks attempt throttling and lockout

- Finding reference: KOWT-018
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A07
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/profile/totp/verify
- CVSS: 6.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:N)

### Description
The TOTP verification endpoint accepted six consecutive invalid codes without applying an attempt limit, temporary lockout, CAPTCHA, or an explicit rate-limit response.

### Impact
An attacker with a valid session could repeatedly guess the six-digit TOTP code, reducing the effectiveness of the second-factor control for transfers.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires a valid session. Six consecutive attempts were accepted without an observable restriction, although testing did not establish whether a higher attempt threshold exists.

### Recommendation
Enforce per-user and per-challenge attempt limits. Apply exponential backoff and short temporary lockouts, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when throttled, invalidate the setup challenge after repeated failures, and monitor repeated verification failures.

### Evidence
```
Six consecutive requests using totp_code 000000 each returned HTTP 403 with the identical TOTP_INVALID response. Attempts 1-5 completed in 8-14 ms and attempt 6 in 595 ms. None returned HTTP 429, a Retry-After header, a lockout response, an attempt counter, or a CAPTCHA.
```

### Request Evidence
```
Six consecutive POST /api/profile/totp/verify requests with {"totp_code":"000000"} under bounded sequence totp-verify-rate-limit-validshape-0912.
```

### Response Evidence
```
Attempts 1-6: HTTP 403 TOTP_INVALID with identical response body; no 429, lockout, CAPTCHA, or Retry-After.
```

### Validation Note
Using the configured `aespa_a9633bc3` session, I sent a fresh bounded sequence of six invalid TOTP codes after the scanner's six attempts. Every request still returned the same HTTP 403 TOTP_INVALID response in 10-17 ms, with no 429, Retry-After header, lockout response, attempt counter, CAPTCHA, or sustained delay. The scanner's isolated 595 ms response was not progressive throttling because later attempts immediately returned to normal latency, and testing beyond the original six attempts found no higher lockout threshold.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{"totp_code":"555555"}' http://localhost:8081/api/profile/totp/verify -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

### Validation Setup
This finding requires an authenticated session (log in as **aespa_a9633bc3** or an equivalent user).

Log in as weakpass_user and copy its bearer token from the Authorization request header.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js

const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

## 35. Admin token accepted by customer authentication boundary

- Finding reference: KOWT-056
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A01
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: false_positive
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/profile
- CVSS: 4.9 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The customer-only /api/profile endpoint accepts an administrator token and treats its numeric subject as customer ID 1.

### Impact
Tokens issued for one security role can access another role's identity context. The observed response disclosed a customer's profile and password hash, and similar role confusion may affect customer actions.

### Likelihood
Moderate. Exploitation requires a valid administrator token, but the cross-role token acceptance was directly observed.

### Recommendation
Include an explicit token audience and role, validate both on every protected route, and keep administrator and customer authentication middleware separate. Never serialize password hashes.

## 36. Administrator credentials and bearer tokens transmitted over HTTP

- Finding reference: KOWT-064
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A02
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: false_positive
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/admin/accounts?page=1&per_page=1
- CVSS: 6.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The administrator account API uses unencrypted HTTP. An Authorization credential was observed on the wire, and the response contained customer names, email addresses, account numbers, balances, and account status.

### Impact
An attacker able to observe the connection could steal the administrator credential and sensitive banking data.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires access to the local or adjacent network path. The observed request confirms that credentials and sensitive data are transmitted without TLS.

### Recommendation
Require HTTPS for all application traffic, redirect HTTP to HTTPS, and enable HSTS after HTTPS is fully deployed. Revoke credentials that may have crossed an untrusted network.

## 37. Bearer SSO token placed in a URL query parameter

- Finding reference: KOWT-060
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A02
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: false_positive
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/insurance/sso
- CVSS: 5.4 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N)

### Description
The insurance SSO endpoint generates an HTTP URL containing a signed bearer token in the token query parameter.

### Impact
The SSO token may be recorded in browser history, proxy or server logs, monitoring systems, and referrer data. Anyone who obtains a valid token may be able to assume the customer's insurance session.

### Likelihood
The token-bearing URL is generated for any authenticated customer. Exploitation depends on an attacker gaining access to a system that records or receives the URL.

### Recommendation
Exchange a short-lived, single-use authorization code through an HTTPS callback instead of placing a bearer JWT in the URL. Prevent referrer leakage and redact authorization codes from logs.

### Evidence
```
An authenticated GET returned an sso_url in the form http://localhost:8001/sso?token=[REDACTED_JWT], confirming that the bearer assertion is transported in the query string over HTTP.

REQUEST:
GET http://localhost:8081/api/insurance/sso
use_session: weakpass_user  Authorization: present
Cookies: none
{}

RESPONSE:
Status: 200
date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 06:53:11 GMT
server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix)
x-powered-by: PHP/8.4.25
access-control-allow-origin: *
access-control-allow-credentials: true
access-control-allow-methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, PATCH, HEAD
access-control-allow-headers: *
access-control-max-age: 86400
content-length: 449
keep-alive: timeout=5, max=100
connection: Keep-Alive
content-type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{"success":true,"data":{"sso_url":"http:\/\/localhost:8001\/sso?token=[REDACTED_JWT]"},"message":"SSO URL generated successfully"}
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET http://localhost:8081/api/insurance/sso
use_session: weakpass_user  Authorization: present
Cookies: none
{}
```

### Response Evidence
```
Status: 200
date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 06:53:11 GMT
server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix)
x-powered-by: PHP/8.4.25
access-control-allow-origin: *
access-control-allow-credentials: true
access-control-allow-methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, PATCH, HEAD
access-control-allow-headers: *
access-control-max-age: 86400
content-length: 449
keep-alive: timeout=5, max=100
connection: Keep-Alive

{"success":true,"data":{"sso_url":"http:\/\/localhost:8001\/sso?token=[REDACTED_JWT]"},"message":"SSO URL generated successfully"}
```

### Validation Note
The generated value is not functioning as a bearer assertion in the live flow. Fresh tokens from both `admin_fresh` and `admin_active_0912` were replayed without authentication at `http://localhost:8001/sso`; each redirected to `/?login=1&error=sso_failed`, exactly the same result as a deliberately malformed `token=bogus`. The direct backend also has no TLS on port 8081, no reachable HTTPS listener on port 443, and ignored forwarded-HTTPS headers, but the specific scanner claim is disproved because the emitted JWT is rejected by its stated SSO consumer rather than acting as a bearer credential.

## 38. Server accepts one-character passwords during registration

- Finding reference: KOWT-003
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A07
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: false_positive
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/auth/register
- CVSS: 5.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The registration endpoint accepts passwords shorter than the eight-character minimum shown in the browser form. The password-length requirement is enforced only by client-side validation and can be bypassed by sending a request directly to the API.

### Impact
Accounts can be created with trivially guessable passwords, increasing the risk of account takeover through password guessing.

### Likelihood
Exploitation is straightforward because registration is unauthenticated and the server accepted a one-character password without modification.

### Recommendation
Enforce password requirements on the server for every account creation and password change flow. Require a reasonable minimum length and reject common or compromised passwords. Retain client-side validation only to provide immediate user feedback.

### Evidence
```
A POST request to /api/auth/register using the one-character password "a" returned HTTP 201. The response reported successful registration and created user ID 17 with email aespa_a9633bc3@example.invalid.
```

### Request Evidence
```
POST /api/auth/register JSON fields first_name=Weak, last_name=Policy, generated email, password=a
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 201 {"success":true,"data":{"user":{"id":17,"email":"aespa_a9633bc3@example.invalid",...},"token":"[REDACTED_JWT]"},"message":"Registration successful"}
```

### Validation Note
The reported 201 response created user record 17, but it did not establish that the one-character value became a usable password. I tested the exact reported email and password against POST /api/auth/login; the server found the account but returned 401 WRONG_PASSWORD. The concrete benign explanation is that registration created a record without installing the supplied one-character value as an accepted credential, so the evidence does not show weak-password authentication.

## 39. Transaction details accessible across customer accounts

- Finding reference: KOWT-087
- Severity: medium
- OWASP: A01
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: false_positive
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/transactions?per_page=10
- CVSS: 6.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The authenticated transaction endpoint returns an aggregate history when account_id is omitted. The response contains transactions for several source accounts, including IDs 1, 2, and 51, without showing that the session is authorized for each account.

### Impact
An authenticated customer could access other customers' transaction details, including recipient account numbers, amounts, descriptions, and internal account identifiers.

### Likelihood
High. Any authenticated user can request the endpoint without account_id, and the observed request immediately returned records from multiple accounts.

### Recommendation
Derive the permitted account IDs from the authenticated customer on the server. Require object-level authorization for every returned transaction and reject requests that would create an unrestricted aggregate query.

## 40. Accounts API reflects arbitrary CORS origins

- Finding reference: KOWT-074
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic

- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/payments/process
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The API reflects an attacker-controlled Origin value and permits credentials on authentication and payment endpoints.

### Impact
A malicious website could read API responses if a victim's browser automatically supplies usable credentials or the application otherwise exposes authorization credentials to cross-origin requests.

### Likelihood
Currently low because the payment request used an explicit bearer token and no browser-based proof demonstrated access to sensitive authenticated data.

### Validation Setup
This finding requires an authenticated session (log in as **admin_fresh** or an equivalent user).

Log in as the admin test user and capture that user's bearer token from the Authorization request header in the browser DevTools Network tab.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js
const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); // or sessionStorage
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

Then move `aespa-poc-auth.txt` next to where you run the command below.

## 42. Admin accounts API reflects arbitrary CORS origins

- Finding reference: KOWT-036
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/admin/system/settings
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The secret-bearing administrator settings endpoint reflects an arbitrary Origin value in Access-Control-Allow-Origin.

### Impact
A malicious web origin may be able to read sensitive integration settings when the administrator's authentication is available to browser requests.

### Likelihood
The endpoint reflects attacker-controlled origins. Browser exploitability depends on how its bearer token is stored and attached.

### Recommendation
Restrict CORS to an explicit list of trusted origins and do not return secrets to browser clients.

### Evidence
```
A request with Origin: https://evil.example returned HTTP 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.example and exposed the insurance URL, merchant identifiers, account routing information, and machine token.

REQUEST:
GET /api/admin/system/settings HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8081
Origin: https://evil.example
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_BEARER] token]

RESPONSE:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.example
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{"success":true,"data":{"insurance_app_url":"http:\/\/localhost:8001","merchant_id":"faceinsurance","merchant_account":"062-001 88880001 (face@example.com)","machine_token":"mch_face_insurance_secret_key_2026"}}
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET /api/admin/system/settings HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8081
Origin: https://evil.example
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED_BEARER] token]
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil.example
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8

{"success":true,"data":{"insurance_app_url":"http:\/\/localhost:8001","merchant_id":"faceinsurance","merchant_account":"062-001 88880001 (face@example.com)","machine_token":"mch_face_insurance_secret_key_2026"}}
```

### Validation Note
I tested the main innocent explanations. An unauthenticated cross-origin GET is rejected with 401, so the bearer token is not ambient browser authentication, but the server still reflects unrelated arbitrary origins on authenticated responses. A browser preflight from evil.example returned 200 and explicitly allowed credentials, GET, and the Authorization header via Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *. Using the listed admin_fresh session with a new random origin then returned the sensitive settings and reflected that exact origin, so this is not a fixed trusted-origin allowlist.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 -H 'Origin: https://cors-check-7f3a.invalid' http://localhost:8081/api/admin/system/settings -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

### Validation Setup
This finding requires an authenticated session (log in as **admin_fresh** or an equivalent user).

Log in as an administrator, capture the bearer token from the Authorization header or browser storage, and send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js
const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); // or sessionStorage
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

## 45. Admin customer update exposes database errors and stack traces

- Finding reference: KOWT-012
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/admin/customers/17
- CVSS: 2.2 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The admin customer update endpoint returns a raw database error and PHP stack trace when an otherwise valid request contains an oversized first_name value.

### Impact
An authenticated administrator can obtain database column details, absolute source paths, line numbers, and application call frames. This information could help an attacker map the application and prepare further attacks.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires administrative access and a specially crafted oversized field value. The disclosure was reliably triggered through a single update request.

### Recommendation
Return a generic error response without exception details. Log full exceptions only on the server, validate field lengths before database operations, and disable stack traces in production responses.

### Evidence
```
A PUT request containing an oversized first_name value returned HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with SQLSTATE[22001], the first_name database column, and a PHP stack trace. The response disclosed paths and call frames including /var/www/html/src/Controllers/AdminUserController.php line 134, AdminRouter.php line 84, and public/index.php line 24.
```

### Request Evidence
```
PUT /api/admin/customers/17 with an oversized first_name string in an otherwise valid JSON customer object.
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with SQLSTATE[22001], database column name first_name, absolute source paths, line numbers, and stack trace.
```

### Validation Note
The first admin session was expired, so I retried with the supplied `admin_fresh` session. A direct PUT with only an oversized `first_name` reproduced HTTP 500 and returned SQLSTATE[22001], the database column name, absolute PHP source paths, line numbers, and a multi-frame stack trace. This is live exception disclosure rather than a generic or hardcoded error response, and no reasonable benign explanation fits the returned diagnostic details.

## 48. Admin interface loads a third-party script without integrity validation

- Finding reference: KOWT-030
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A08
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/admin/
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N)

### Description
The administrator interface at /admin/ loads the Tailwind browser script from a public CDN without a Subresource Integrity attribute.

### Impact
If the CDN resource or its delivery path is compromised, malicious JavaScript could execute in administrator sessions and access data or privileged functions available to the affected browser session.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires compromise of the third-party CDN resource or its delivery path and an administrator to load the page. No such compromise was demonstrated.

### Recommendation
Self-host a pinned production build of the dependency. If the script must be loaded from a CDN, use a fixed version with a verified Subresource Integrity hash and a crossorigin attribute. Add a restrictive Content Security Policy that permits scripts only from required sources.

### Evidence
```
GET /admin/ returned HTTP 200 HTML containing <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script> without an integrity attribute.
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET http://localhost:8081/admin/
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200 HTML: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
```

### Validation Note
The authenticated admin page returned an executable third-party script tag for https://cdn.tailwindcss.com with no integrity attribute, and the response supplied no Content-Security-Policy that would block it. I also checked the CDN URL: it redirects to a versioned Tailwind asset over HTTPS, but the browser still accepts whatever bytes the third party serves because the page provides no cryptographic integrity value. The versioned redirect and long cache lifetime reduce accidental changes but do not disprove the reported supply-chain weakness.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 http://localhost:8081/admin/ -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

Log in as the admin user and copy the bearer token from the Authorization request header in the browser Network panel.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js
const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); // or sessionStorage
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

## 49. Admin interface omits browser security headers

- Finding reference: KOWT-020
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/admin/
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The HTML response for the admin interface does not include Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers. The response also discloses the exact Apache version, and the page loads executable JavaScript from cdn.tailwindcss.com.

### Impact
The missing headers reduce browser protections against clickjacking, MIME-type confusion, referrer leakage, and the effects of HTML injection. The Apache version disclosure may help an attacker identify version-specific techniques.

### Likelihood
The missing headers are directly observable, but practical exploitation depends on another weakness or successful user interaction. No direct compromise was demonstrated.

### Recommendation
Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, including an appropriate frame-ancestors directive. Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy. Use X-Frame-Options where legacy browser support is required. Suppress detailed Apache version information and self-host production JavaScript where practical.

### Evidence
```
An authenticated GET request to /admin/ returned HTTP 200 with Server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix). The response did not include Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy. The returned page also loads executable code from https://cdn.tailwindcss.com.
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET /admin/ Authorization: Bearer [admin session]
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200; Server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix); missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy.
```

### Validation Note
A fresh direct GET with the supplied admin_test session returned the full 19,612-byte admin HTML page with HTTP 200. The response still omitted Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy; its complete head contained no meta CSP equivalent, while it disclosed Server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix) and loaded executable JavaScript from https://cdn.tailwindcss.com. This rules out stale scanner evidence, a login redirect, an empty response, and proxy-added protection on the directly tested endpoint.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 http://localhost:8081/admin/ -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

### Validation Setup
This finding requires an authenticated session (log in as **admin_test** or an equivalent user).

Log in as the admin_test user and copy its Authorization bearer token from the browser Network panel.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js
const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); // or sessionStorage
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

Then move `aespa-poc-auth.txt` next to where you run the command below.

### Validation Note
A direct anonymous request to /admin/ reproduced the 200 response with Apache/2.4.68 and no CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy. The HTML head has no meta policy that compensates for those headers, and an authenticated admin request returned the same header set and static shell. The URL fragment is client-side, so /admin/ is the correct reproducible request; the omission is therefore real rather than proxy stripping or a route mismatch.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 http://localhost:8081/admin/
```

## 51. Admin password reset accepts a common password

- Finding reference: KOWT-022
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A07
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/api/admin/customers/17/reset-password
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The administrator password-reset endpoint enforces a minimum password length but allows an administrator to reset a customer account password to the common password "password".

### Impact
Customer accounts may be assigned widely guessed passwords during administrator-assisted resets, increasing the risk of account takeover.

### Likelihood
Exploitation requires an administrator to assign a weak password and an attacker to identify or guess it. The accepted password is common and easily guessed.

### Recommendation
Reject passwords found in breached or common-password lists during password creation and reset. For administrator-initiated resets, use a secure temporary password or reset link and require the customer to choose a new password at the next login.

### Evidence
```
A one-character password was rejected, but POSTing {"password":"password"} for customer 17 returned HTTP 200 with success=true and the message "Password reset successfully".
```

### Request Evidence
```
POST /api/admin/customers/17/reset-password body {"password":"password"}
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200 {"success":true,"data":null,"message":"Password reset successfully"}
```

### Validation Note
The endpoint returned a specific validation error for a one-character password but returned 200 and "Password reset successfully" for the common password "password", so the success response is not generic. Customer 17 is an active login-capable account, and an anonymous login using that customer's email and the reset password succeeded immediately with no forced-password-change step. I found no innocent explanation such as a no-op reset, inactive account, or temporary credential workflow.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{"password":"password"}' http://localhost:8081/api/admin/customers/17/reset-password -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat aespa-poc-auth.txt)"
```

### Validation Setup
This finding requires an authenticated session (log in as **admin_fresh** or an equivalent user).

Log in as an administrator, then copy the bearer token from the Authorization header in the browser Network panel.

Capture the credential into a file named `aespa-poc-auth.txt` in the directory you run the command from:

In the browser DevTools Console (adjust the storage key for the app):
```js
const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); // or sessionStorage
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([token], {type:'text/plain'}));
a.download = 'aespa-poc-auth.txt'; a.click();
```

Then move `aespa-poc-auth.txt` next to where you run the command below.

## 52. Banking interface omits browser security headers

- Finding reference: KOWT-021
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/banking/
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The authenticated banking page at /banking/ does not return Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers. The response also discloses Apache/2.4.68 (Unix) and loads JavaScript from cdn.tailwindcss.com.

### Impact
The missing headers reduce browser protections against clickjacking, content-type confusion, referrer leakage, and the effects of HTML injection. The Apache version disclosure may help an attacker identify relevant component-specific attacks.

### Likelihood
The missing headers and server version are directly observable, but meaningful exploitation would generally require user interaction or another weakness such as HTML injection.

### Recommendation
Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, including frame-ancestors, or set X-Frame-Options. Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy. Suppress detailed Server version information and self-host production JavaScript where practical.

### Evidence
```
GET /banking/ returned HTTP 200 with Server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix). Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy were absent. The HTML loaded https://cdn.tailwindcss.com.
```

### Request Evidence
```
GET /banking/ with a valid customer bearer session
```

### Response Evidence
```
HTTP 200; Server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix); missing Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy.
```

### Validation Note
A direct GET returned the banking application shell with HTTP 200 and omitted Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy while disclosing Apache/2.4.68 (Unix). The document head contains no meta CSP and explicitly loads https://cdn.tailwindcss.com. An anonymous-versus-listed-session comparison produced the same response, so the page is a public static shell rather than an authenticated HTML response, but that does not explain or compensate for the missing browser protections.

### Validation Command
```
curl -s -S -i -k -L --max-time 20 http://localhost:8081/banking/
```

## 53. Banking interface omits browser security headers

- Finding reference: KOWT-092
- Severity: low
- OWASP: A05
- Source: Dynamic
- Validation: confirmed
- Affected URL: http://localhost:8081/banking/#/accounts
- CVSS: 3.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

### Description
The banking page response lacks protections such as Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy.

### Impact
The missing headers reduce browser-side protection against clickjacking, content injection, MIME confusion, and referrer leakage.

### Likelihood
Exploitation depends on a separate injection, framing, or content-handling weakness. No such exploit was demonstrated by these probes.

### Recommendation
Add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, prevent unauthorized framing, set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and configure an appropriate Referrer-Policy.

### Evidence
```
The 200 HTML response contains none of the listed browser security headers.

REQUEST:
GET http://localhost:8081/banking/#/accounts
use_session: anonymous  Authorization: none
Cookies: none
{"X-Rewrite-URL": "/banking/#/accounts"}

RESPONSE:
Status: 200
date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:15:00 GMT
server: Apache/2.4.68 (Unix)
last-modified: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 07:37:51 GMT
etag: "a1ed-659b1f26431c0"
accept-ranges: bytes
content-length: 41453
keep-alive: timeout=5, max=100
connection: Keep-Alive
content-type: text/html

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>The Bank of Ed - Internet Banking</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            navy: {
              50: '#f0f4fa', 100: '#d9e2f0', 200: '#b3c5e1', 300: '#8da8d2',
              400: '#6a8ec4', 500: '#4a74b5', 600: '#3a5d94', 700: '#2a4673',
              800: '#1a2f52', 900: '#0f1a2e', 950: '#0a1120'
            }
          },
          fontFamily: { sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif'] }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/app.css?v=20260213-2">
</head>
<body class="bg-slate-50 font-sans text-slate-800">

  <!-- Toast Container -->
  <div id="toast-container" class="fixed top-4 right-4 z-50 space-y-2"></div>

  <!-- Modal Overlay -->
  <div id="modal-overlay" class="hidden fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
    <div id="modal-content" class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- ===================== AUTH VIEW ===================== -->
  <div id="view-auth" class="hidden min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br from-navy-900 via-navy-800 to-navy-950 p-4">
    <div class="w-full max-w-md">
      <!-- Logo -->
      <div class="text-center mb-8">
        <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-3">
          <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-500 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center">
            <svg class="w-7 h-7 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
          </div>
          <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-white">The Bank of Ed</h1>
        </div>
        <p class="text-navy-300 mt-2">Internet Banking</p>
      </div>

      <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Auth Tabs -->
        <div class="flex border-b border-slate-200">
          <button id="auth-tab-login" onclick="BankOfEd.AuthPage.toggleTab('login')" class="flex-1 py-4 text-center font-semibold text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600 transition-colors">Sign In</button>
          <button id="auth-tab-register" onclick="BankOfEd.AuthPage.toggleTab('register')" class="flex-1 py-4 text-center font-semibold text-slate-400 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors">Create Account</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Login Form -->
        <div id="auth-login-form" class="p-8">
          <form id="login-form" onsubmit="BankOfEd.AuthPage.handleLogin(event)">
            <div class="space-y-5">
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email</label>
                <input type="email" name="email" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="you@example.com">
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Password</label>
                <input type="password" name="password" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Enter your password">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="login-errors" class="mt-4 text-sm text-red-600 hidden"></div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-full mt-6 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <span>Sign In</span>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin hidden" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"></path></svg>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Register Form -->
        <div id="auth-register-form" class="p-8 hidden">
          <form id="register-form" onsubmit="BankOfEd.AuthPage.handleRegister(event)">
            <div class="space-y-5">
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">First Name</label>
                  <input type="text" name="first_name" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Edward">
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Last Name</label>
                  <input type="text" name="last_name" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Chow">
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email</label>
                <input type="email" name="email" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="you@example.com">
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Password</label>
                <input type="password" name="password" required minlength="8" class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Min 8 characters">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="register-errors" class="mt-4 text-sm text-red-600 hidden"></div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-full mt-6 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <span>Create Account</span>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin hidden" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"></path></svg>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ===================== APP SHELL ===================== -->
  <div id="app-shell" class="hidden flex h-screen overflow-hidden">

    <!-- Mobile Header -->
    <div id="mobile-header" class="lg:hidden fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 bg-navy-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3">
      <button id="hamburger-btn" onclick="BankOfEd.App.toggleSidebar()" class="p-2 hover:bg-navy-800 rounded-lg">
        <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"></path></svg>
      </button>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div class="w-8 h-8 bg-blue-500 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
        </div>
        <span class="font-semibold">The Bank of Ed</span>
      </div>
      <div class="w-10"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Sidebar Overlay (mobile) -->
    <div id="sidebar-overlay" onclick="BankOfEd.App.toggleSidebar()" class="hidden fixed inset-0 z-30 bg-black/50 lg:hidden"></div>

    <!-- Sidebar -->
    <aside id="sidebar" class="fixed lg:static inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 w-64 bg-navy-900 text-white flex flex-col transform -translate-x-full lg:translate-x-0 transition-transform duration-200">
      <!-- Logo -->
      <div class="p-6 flex items-center gap-3">
        <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-blue-500 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
          <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 class="font-bold text-lg">The Bank of Ed</h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-navy-400">Internet Banking</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Nav Links -->
      <nav class="flex-1 px-3 space-y-1 mt-2">
        <a href="#/dashboard" data-nav="dashboard" class="nav-link flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6"></path></svg>
          <span>Dashboard</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#/accounts" data-nav="accounts" class="nav-link flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"></path></svg>
          <span>Accounts</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#/transfers" data-nav="transfers" class="nav-link flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"></path></svg>
          <span>Transfer</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#/addressbook" data-nav="addressbook" class="nav-link flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path></svg>
          <span>Address Book</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#/profile" data-nav="profile" class="nav-link flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"></path></svg>
          <span>Profile</span>
        </a>
        <a href="#/insurance" id="nav-insurance" onclick="BankOfEd.App.launchInsurance(event)" data-nav="insurance" class="nav-link flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors group">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 group-hover:text-amber-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path></svg>
            <span>Insurance</span>
          </div>
          <svg class="w-4 h-4 opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-100 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-all" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10 6H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-4M14 4h6m0 0v6m0-6L10 14"></path></svg>
        </a>
      </nav>

      <!-- User / Logout -->
      <div class="p-4 border-t border-navy-800">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3 px-2">
          <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-navy-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-semibold overflow-hidden" id="sidebar-avatar">?</div>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <p class="text-sm font-medium truncate" id="sidebar-user-name">User</p>
            <p class="text-xs text-navy-400 truncate" id="sidebar-user-email">user@email.com</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button onclick="BankOfEd.App.logout()" class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-navy-400 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors text-sm">
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 16l4-4m0 0l-4-4m4 4H7m6 4v1a3 3 0 01-3 3H6a3 3 0 01-3-3V7a3 3 0 013-3h4a3 3 0 013 3v1"></path></svg>
          <span>Sign Out</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- Main Content -->
    <main class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pt-14 lg:pt-0">
      <div class="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">

        <!-- Page Loader -->
        <div id="page-loader" class="hidden fixed inset-0 z-20 bg-white/60 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div class="loader"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Dashboard -->
        <section id="page-dashboard" class="hidden">
          <div class="mb-8">
            <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">Welcome back, <span id="dash-username">User</span></h1>
            <p class="text-slate-500 mt-1">Here's your financial overview</p>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-700 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white mb-8">
            <p class="text-blue-100 text-sm font-medium">Total Balance</p>
            <p class="text-3xl font-bold mt-1" id="dash-total-balance">$0.00</p>
          </div>
          <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 mb-4">Your Accounts</h2>
          <div id="dash-accounts" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8"></div>

          <!-- White-Label Insurance Card -->
          <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-navy-900 to-navy-800 rounded-2xl p-6 text-white mb-8 border border-navy-700 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-amber-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path></svg>
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-lg text-white">FACE Insurance Partner Portal</h3>
                <p class="text-sm text-navy-200 mt-0.5">Manage your motor, home, and contents policies or lodge claims with single sign-on.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button onclick="BankOfEd.App.launchInsurance(event)" class="bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap self-start md:self-auto shadow">
              <span>Launch FACE Insurance</span>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M10 6H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-4M14 4h6m0 0v6m0-6L10 14"></path></svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">Recent Activity</h2>
            </div>
            <div id="dash-transactions" class="divide-y divide-slate-100"></div>
            <div id="dash-no-transactions" class="hidden p-8 text-center text-slate-400">No recent transactions</div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Accounts List -->
        <section id="page-accounts" class="hidden">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
            <div>
              <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">Accounts</h1>
              <p class="text-slate-500 mt-1">Manage your bank accounts</p>
            </div>
            <button onclick="BankOfEd.AccountsPage.showNewAccountModal()" class="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
              <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"></path></svg>
              <span class="hidden sm:inline">Open Account</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          <div id="accounts-list" class="space-y-4"></div>
          <div id="accounts-empty" class="hidden bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-12 text-center">
            <svg class="w-16 h-16 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1.5" d="M3 10h18M7 15h1m4 0h1m-7 4h12a3 3 0 003-3V8a3 3 0 00-3-3H6a3 3 0 00-3 3v8a3 3 0 003 3z"></path></svg>
            <p class="text-slate-500 text-lg">No accounts yet</p>
            <p class="text-slate-400 mt-1">Open your first account to get started</p>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Account Detail -->
        <section id="page-account-detail" class="hidden">
          <a href="#/accounts" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 text-sm font-medium mb-6">
            <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"></path></svg>
            Back to Accounts
          </a>
          <div id="account-detail-header" class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 p-6 mb-6"></div>
          <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-100">
              <h2 class="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">Transaction History</h2>
            </div>
            <div id="account-detail-transactions"></div>
            <div id="account-detail-pagination" class="px-6 py-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between"></div>
          </div>
        </section>

        <!-- Transfers -->
        <section id="page-transfers" class="hidden">
          <div class="mb-8">
            <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900">Transfer Money</h1>
            <p class="text-slate-500 mt-1">Send money between accounts or to someone else</p>
          </div>
          <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
            <!-- Transfer Tabs -->
            <div class="flex border-b border-slate-200">
              <button id="transfer-tab-own" onclick="BankOfEd.TransfersPage.switchTab('own')" class="flex-1 py-4 text-center font-semibold text-blue-600 border-b-2 border-blue-600 transition-colors">Between Own Accounts</button>
              <button id="transfer-tab-external" onclick="BankOfEd.TransfersPage.switchTab('external')" class="flex-1 py-4 text-center font-semibold text-slate-400 border-b-2 border-transparent hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors">Pay Someone</button>
            </div>

            <!-- Own Transfer -->
            <div id="transfer-own-panel" class="p-6 sm:p-8">
              <form id="transfer-own-form" onsubmit="BankOfEd.TransfersPage.handleOwnTransfer(event)" class="space-y-5 max-w-lg">
                <div>
                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">From Account</label>
                  <select id="transfer-own-from" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition bg-white"></select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">To Account</label>
                  <select id="transfer-own-to" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition bg-white"></select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label id="transfer-own-amount-label" class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Amount (AUD)</label>
                  <input type="number" id="transfer-own-amount" required step="0.01" min="0.01" class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="0.00" oninput="BankOfEd.TransfersPage.onOwnAmountChange && BankOfEd.TransfersPage.onOwnAmountChange()">

                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">First Name</label>
```
```
                  <input type="text" name="first_name" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Edward">
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Last Name</label>
                  <input type="text" name="last_name" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Chow">
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Email</label>
                <input type="email" name="email" required class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="you@example.com">
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Password</label>
                <input type="password" name="password" required minlength="8" class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none transition" placeholder="Min 8 characters">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="register-errors" class="mt-4 text-sm text-red-600 hidden"></div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-full mt-6 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <span>Create Account</span>
              <svg class="w-4 h-4 animate-spin hidden" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4z"></path></svg>
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

      </button>

          <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"></path></svg>

          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"></path></svg>

        </a>
        <a href="#/insurance" id="nav-insurance" onclick="BankOfEd.App.launchInsurance(event)" data-nav="insurance" class="nav-link flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-navy-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-navy-800 transition-colors group">

            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 group-hover:text-amber-300" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"></path></svg>

          <div class="min-w-0">

            <p class="text-xs text-navy-400 truncate" id="sidebar-user-email">user@email.com</p>

          <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M17 16l4-4m0 0l-4-4m4 4H7m6 4v1a3 3 0 01-3 3H6a3 3 0 01-3-3V7a3 3 0 013-3h4a3 3 0 013 3v1"></path></svg>
          <span>Sign Out</span>
        </button>
      </div>
```
